about_me.title: About me
about_me.content: My name is Dmitry Bersenev. I’m a front-end developer creating responsive and interactive web applications using modern technologies such as React, TypeScript, JavaScript, and CSS/SCSS. I’ve worked on various projects — from corporate applications and e-commerce platforms to mini apps at hackathons. In every project, I focus on building user-friendly and visually appealing interfaces, paying close attention to user experience and clean code. Here you can explore my work, learn about my experience and the technologies I use, and get in touch if you’d like to collaborate!

projects.title: Fastuna
projects.description: This is one of the most interesting projects I have worked on. I have been involved in improving the Fastuna website, fixing bugs, and implementing additional features to make the platform more user-friendly and stable. This work has allowed me to gain a deep understanding of modern front-end technologies, interface optimization, and dynamic content interaction, and my code has undergone rigorous testing and review to ensure the high quality of the product.

projects.title: Markers Unity
projects.description: One of the applications I worked on during my internship. I had to develop an interface for a mobile marker app that allows you to create custom color picker scenarios using the service. Working on the app allowed me to learn a lot about mobile responsiveness, interface components, app state management, and API requests for server interaction.

projects.title: Test Digital Element Task
projects.description: A test assignment for the Digital Element, where I created a responsive homepage using Flex, Grid, BEM, and SVG. I implemented a modal window with a form, including validation in pure JS/TS, data submission, and successful pop-up display. This project allowed me to improve my skills in modular code structure, component reuse, and working with modern build tools (Webpack/Vite, PostCSS/SCSS, ESLint).

experiences.title: Front-end Developer
experiences.description: Created and maintained the user interface of the Fastuna project, ensuring responsiveness, interactivity, and proper component functionality.

experiences.title: Full-stack Developer
experiences.description: Developed an e-commerce platform for selling meat products. Implemented the frontend using React JS and TypeScript, backend with ASP.NET Core Web API, and integrated a database for product management and order processing.

experiences.title: Front-end Intern
experiences.description: Worked on the frontend part of the Markers Unity project, creating the mobile marker app interface and integrating with APIs.

experiences.title: Participant
experiences.description: Developed a mini app 'Translator' with a responsive interface and API request handling.

experiences.title: Intern
experiences.description: Integrated an application for managing passes at the plant, ensuring correct interface display and interaction with internal services.
